predecessors.note: The page calls Xi 'a Chinese vassal state under the Shang and Zhou dynasties'; the infobox date 1122 BC is a Shang-era year.

successors.note: 'Sometime between 680 and 684 BCE Xi was annexed by the State of Chu'; 'King Wen subsequently set up the counties of Shen and Xi in the areas of the former eponymous states.' The chu dossier carries the gain at 684 with a Xinyang 45 km disc.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks Xi). Infobox 'Established: 1122 BC', 'Disestablished: Between 684 and 680 BC', Marquessate; location not stated, capital Xi County. No area. The 35 km disc is at Xi County, whose seat lies some 60 km east of Xinyang, where the chu dossier puts its gain: the two should be reconciled.

ledger.note: 1122 BC: the infobox's founding year for the Marquessate of Xi. The page says nothing of its founding beyond the infobox ('Established: 1122 BC').

684: Chu overthrows Xi. 'In 684 BCE, Duke Ai of Cai was rude to Xī Guī, wife of the Duke of Xī'; the Duke of Xi asked Chu to feign an attack; 'King Wen overthrew the State of Xī and married Xī Guī'; 'Sometime between 680 and 684 BCE Xi was annexed by the State of Chu.' The first year of the span is used.
684: the state of Xi ends in Chu's annexation (infobox 'Disestablished: Between 684 and 680 BC'); it became a Chu county.

wars.name: Xi punitive expedition against Zheng
wars.outcome: 'In 712 BCE the State of Xi sent a punitive expedition against the State of Zhèng' and suffered a 'decisive defeat'; no land changed hands.
wars.note: Listed so the reviewer can see it was considered.

wars.name: Chu conquest of Xi
wars.outcome: King Wen of Chu overthrew Xi between 684 and 680 BC (the Xi Gui story) and made it a county; in 680 he 'overthrew the State of Cài' at Xi Gui's behest.
wars.note: Cai's fall in 680 is the Xi page's sentence ('in 680 BCE, at her behest, overthrew the State of Cài'); the chu dossier of ea-01-a shows Cai alive and taken by Chu in 531-447, so the two do not agree; not used here.

certainty.note: No Xi boundary is on the page; soft throughout.

sources.title: Xi (state)
sources.note: Infobox (1122 BC to between 684 and 680 BC, capital Xi County, Marquessate); 712 expedition against Zheng; 684 Xi Gui story and Chu annexation; counties of Shen and Xi.

notes: Page opened (1 of 1-2): Xi (state). Wikidata id left null (unreachable). START -1122 is the infobox year (confidence 2; Shang-era, earlier than the Zhou founding). END -684 is the first year of 'between 684 and 680' and equals the chu dossier's year. LOCATION: the page gives only the capital name 'Xi County' (modern Xi County, Henan, by the researcher's reading, 32.34 N 114.73 E): the chu dossier draws Xi as Xinyang 45 km. AREA: none. No rulers. The 680 fall of Cai on this page conflicts with the cai dossier of ea-01-a; unresolved here.
